articles.title: Bitcoin heads higher as President Trump announces Iran peace agreement
articles.snippet: "An Agreement has been largely negotiated, subject to finalization between the United States of America, the Islamic Republic of Iran, and the various other Countries," wrote President Trump late Saturday afternoon.

articles.title: Bitcoin is ready to beat stocks and bonds again after underperformance against Wall Street
articles.snippet: Former Credit Suisse global head of portfolio and Risk Dimensions CIO Mark Connors says bitcoin has broken out of its longest stretch of underperformance in history and is ready to beat stocks, bonds, and gold as inflation stubbornly sticks around.

articles.title: Analysts forecast a Bitcoin crash to the $60K level, revisiting 2026 low
articles.snippet: The price of Bitcoin is about $75,800 at the time of publication, a nearly 40% decrease from the all-time high of about $126,000 reached in October 2025.

articles.title: Argentina Launched an AI to Predict the Future. It Couldn't Predict a Typo
articles.snippet: Milei's government unveiled a social digital twin to overhaul public policy—announced via a video full of AI slop, grammatical errors, and a deepfake of a minister.

articles.title: Crypto, Banks, Policy Experts Press Congress to Modernize Bank Secrecy Act
articles.snippet: A House subcommittee hearing exposed a divide over how far to scale back the 1970-era anti-money laundering law as Trump expands its reach.
